The full record isfree with an accountor through the [API](https://indexed.vc/docs/api). ## About Bitly is a connections platform providing URL shortening, QR code generation, link-in-bio landing pages, and link analytics for businesses and marketers. Founded in 2008, Bitly enables brands to shorten, brand, share, and track links across digital and physical channels. The platform serves over 600,000 paying customers globally, processes 10 billion connections monthly, and integrates with 800+ applications including Shopify and Canva. Bitly's analytics layer helps marketing, retail, healthcare, and enterprise teams measure engagement and optimize customer journeys across web, email, and print. Summary It lists 201–500 employees. It has raised $95.0M in total across 5 rounds, most recently a $63.0M Growth Equity round in Jul 2017. Investors include Spectrum Equity, Khosla Ventures and RRE Ventures.
